literal: the one they love - soft shoulder - than sleeping - is it sweeter - lotus - he who has eyes - world
translation: Is the world of the lotus-eyed god sweeter than sleeping on the soft shoulders of the one they love?
modern: தாம் விரும்பும் காதலியின் மென்மையான தோள்களில் சாய்ந்து தூங்குவதை விட, தாமரைக் கண்ணனாகிய கடவுளின் உலகம் இனிமையானதோ?
explanation: The speaker asks a rhetorical question comparing the joys of love to the ultimate spiritual reward. He wonders if the heavenly world of the lotus-eyed god could possibly be sweeter than resting on the soft shoulders of his beloved. The word 'கொல்' is an interrogative particle that implies doubt, showing he believes nothing can surpass the joy of his lover's embrace. The phrase 'தாமரைக் கண்ணான் உலகு' refers to a divine paradise, emphasizing the supreme value he places on earthly love.
